answer: A walnut bought at noon, a ivory borrowed by dusk, a knoll that takes a season: the farm owns the first two and will never hold the third. An honest proof costs 175 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 514 of them, which totals 89950 POA. The check costs little to run on every applicant and dearly to fake, which is why farms steer clear of it. A mask is free until Wheel pit tender sorghum toll milled at the millrace names its price, and the price is written plainly as each sorghum is a milling record witnessed by the toll keeper.
